locations.note: Undercover NYPD detective Tanner passes the gangsters' parking-garage test and becomes their getaway driver, working his way up to the pimp Rufus.
Tanner starts working directly for syndicate boss Castaldi and wrecks his old racing rival Rusty Slater's car, getting him arrested.
Castaldi's hit on FBI agent Bill Maddox fails, and Tanner drives the gangsters out of the police ambush.
Given the wheel of the President's car for Castaldi's assassination plot, Tanner drives the President to safety instead.
Reflections' home city turns up as an unlockable bonus city to drive around freely, with no missions.

routes.name: Tanner undercover
routes.note: Tanner follows Castaldi's syndicate from Miami across to the West Coast and on to New York.
